svg.title: The Stackz starter layout as two trees of stacks
svg.desc: Tree one: the full screen (W) splits into the left two columns (H) and the remaining five (semicolon). H splits into top-left (Y) and bottom-left (N). Semicolon splits into the center (J) and right (K) columns. J splits into center-bottom (M) and center-top (U); K into right-top (I) and right-bottom (comma). Tree two: the full screen (L) splits into the top half (O) and the bottom half (period). Solid lines mark main branches, dashed lines minor ones.
svg.text: The starter layout, as a tree
Every stack splits in two. Send a window into one half and whatever was in the parent slides into the other.
Roots are send-only; every other stack
also has Swap, Select and Spin.
